registry.label: 衰减代理
registry.definition: 每单位已冻结放电量的研究代理；未取得电池更换成本/寿命曲线，不是淘科实际衰减。

registry.label: 现货按量手续费
registry.definition: 官方FY2024/25/26按量选项；0.03用于买卖成交量。选择此计费方式及单站承担全部费用是C，修改费率后为C。

registry.label: JEPX计费方式
registry.definition: 官方亦提供100万JPY/月定额；会员合同和站点分摊未知。按量、定额或自定义均为研究选择。

registry.label: 会员定额选项
registry.definition: 启用定额时按覆盖的自然月计整月，并乘C分摊比例；不是每座站的实际账单。

registry.label: 会员定额分摊
registry.definition: 会员月费归属于此示例设备的比例，非真实项目分摊。

registry.label: 聚合服务
registry.definition: 分别乘max(spot gross,0)和capacity gross；亏损时不会出现负费用返还。

registry.label: 网络费用代理
registry.definition: 仅为进口电量扣费研究代理，不等于属地输配电全套电量/容量费；实际合同未知。

registry.label: 其他运营额度
registry.definition: 可编辑研究额度；不代表固定O&M、土地、保险和税务已纳入。

registry.label: 一次容量手续费
registry.definition: EPRX FY2026税前单位费；沿用v2对CY2026 YTD统一费率的C反事实口径，修改后为C。

registry.label: 激活/SOC恢复手动额度
registry.definition: 默认Not Modelled；仅在用户显式启用时扣额度，不代表已模拟激活电量和SOC恢复轨迹。

registry.label: 全天预留功率
registry.definition: 与v2资源前沿同一档位；现货功率2−r，首尾SOC50%，静态双向5min余量。

formulas.gross: spot discharge receipts − charging energy cost + reserved capacity units × scenario price
formulas.efficiency: 88% round-trip efficiency is already embedded in dispatch/energy balances, not a second money deduction
formulas.units: reserveMW × 1000 × hours/day × 2 × historical days × delivered ratio
formulas.net: gross − degradation − spot market fee − capacity market fee − aggregation − network − other − explicit activation allowance
formulas.opportunityCostAdjusted: combined net(r) − same LP spot-only net(0) under identical cost assumptions
formulas.breakEvenDegradation: (gross − all costs except degradation)/(grid discharge MWh×1000)
formulas.breakEvenAggregation: (gross − all costs except aggregation)/(max(spot gross,0)+capacity gross)×100
formulas.breakEvenCapacityPrice: (spot net(0) − spot net(r) + capacity fee + explicit activation allowance)/(capacity units × (1−aggregator fraction))
formulas.normalization: net / nominal MW or nominal MWh × 365 / covered historical days; YTD scaling is a comparison convention, not forecast
formulas.fixedSchedule: Cost changes deduct from frozen schedules; they do not re-optimize actions for net income. No-action reference is zero.
